detail.longDescription: Shoot an enemy in a Doom game and a real Kubernetes pod gets deleted. Heath shows me how Splunk connected two games to a live e-commerce demo, used Chaos Mesh to introduce failures, and captured the impact in dashboards. It’s a practical way to see Kubernetes and observability in action. Watch the video on YouTube: https:// youtu.be/AdeIrffwzCY Big thanks to Cisco & Splunk for sponsoring my trip to .Conf 2026 and also for sponsoring this video. # SplunkSponsored # Kubernetes # SplunkConf
